name: Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy S24
summary: The Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy S24 is a standard Samsung Galaxy S24 converted by Atexxo for hazardous areas, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX. It combines increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic). The phone runs One UI 8.5 (Android 16) or later.
imageAlt: Atexxo Zone 2 Galaxy S24, front view

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ec ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIB T135°C Dc
atex.scope: Unit assessment: each unit is checked by a notified body. No certificate number is published.

certification.protection: Increased safety and intrinsic safety (Ex ec ic)

safety.conditions: Charge in safe area. Each unit spark-tested for intrinsically safe circuits (per Atexxo).

specs.chip: Exynos 2400 (UK/EU) / Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 for Galaxy (US, China)
specs.camera: 50 MP main + 12 MP ultra wide + 10 MP 3x telephoto
specs.batteryLife: Up to 29 hours of video playback
specs.keys: Side key (configurable double press / press and hold); volume

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk

capabilities.label: Satellite SOS
capabilities.value: Carrier-dependent on the phone (US only); not verified through housing

strengths: Security updates expected until at least January 2031
A standard Samsung Galaxy S24 inside, with Samsung Knox device management
limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: not rated for conductive dust
Certified by ATEX unit assessment; no certificate number is published
